confidence_interval.excerpt: We found no effect of a multivitamin on prostate cancer (HR, 0.98; 95% CI, 0.88–1.09; P =0.76), whereas a multivitamin significantly reduced the risk of total cancer excluding prostate cancer (HR, 0.88; 95% CI, 0.79–0.98; P =0.023).
